policy.mask: Identical finite positive GT depth pixels in the common context; target excluded
policy.scale: One median(GT/prediction) over finite positive predictions in the entire common context
policy.scoring: Score every fixed-mask pixel, including finite zero and negative predictions; no clipping or removal
policy.nonfinite: Any nonfinite prediction on the fixed mask fails geometry only
policy.diagnostics: Report nonpositive and nonfinite counts/fractions separately, plus legacy strict scores/failures
policy.effect_floor_note: Prospectively fixed for this pilot-selected follow-up, informed by the exploratory run; not a significance threshold
policy.stable_raw_transition: Every DROP-minus-clean combination is positive and every DROP-minus-ADD combination is negative
policy.stable_effect_transition: Every DROP-minus-clean combination exceeds +0.0005 and every DROP-minus-ADD combination is below -0.0005
policy.uncertainty: Observed repeat ranges, no scene-level confidence intervals or p-values; same-seed numerical repeatability
